# Safe code review: payment-link offer filtering

Full review of the committed range only, base `56c05cd` → head `a43549a` (2 commits). I made no edits, ran no tests, used no `gh`, and wrote no run-history file.

24 files, +1,334 −76 · stated rules come from `AGENTS.md` and `docs/agents/*` · 9 of 9 areas have something to check

## Summary

| | |
|---|---|
| **Verdict** | You can open the PR, but first either sort out the rollout for the new `gracePeriod` tag or put a gate on it (finding 1) |
| **Score** | **~93 / 100** · 4 of 4 findings were checked by both a validator and a refuter |
| **What held the score down** | The filter shipping with no way to switch it off; a merge-precedence rule that no test actually checks |
| **Fix first** | Finding 1 |

## Scores by area (worst first)

| Area | Score | Findings |
|---|---|---|
| Regression | 85 | 1 Medium |
| Testing | 82 | 1 Medium, 1 Low |
| Architecture | 99 | 1 Nit |
| Security, Bugs, Performance, DRY, KISS, Conventions | 100 | none |

## What this review did not cover

- **The live Stripe / billing-api catalog.** The review can't see whether production trial links already carry the `gracePeriod` tag, or whether billing-api sends `trialPeriodDays` today.
- **Anything at runtime.** No tests were run; every conclusion comes from reading the code.

## Fix before opening

### 1. The new offer filter has no rollout gate: untagged live trial links disappear and return 403 on deploy (Medium · P2 · confirmed)
**Where:** `src/modules/billing/routes/billing.service.ts:153`, with the rule at `src/modules/billing/domain/payment-link-offer.rules.ts:41` and the checkout rejection at `billing.service.ts:128`.

- **What:** Every request now filters the general trial links. Any trial link that doesn't have the new `gracePeriod` metadata (`entitlements.constants.ts:81`) is offered to nobody.
  - Because `createCheckoutUrl` reuses the same list, checking out such a link now returns 403 instead of opening a Stripe session.
  - The filter runs whatever `enforcementStartsAt` is set to, and no `FF_*` / `features.*` flag switches it off. `FF_BILLING_SERVICE` turns off the whole billing module, not just this filter.
- **Why it matters:** `gracePeriod` is new in this diff, so every trial link already in the catalog is untagged unless someone retagged it out of band. Right after deploy, those offers vanish and their checkouts fail.
- **What limits it:** `warnOnUnclassifiedTrials` (`billing.service.ts:176-198`) logs a warning the first time each untagged link is dropped. The failure is visible, not silent.
- **Adjudication:** the validator CONFIRMED it; the refuter WEAKENED it, lowering likelihood from L3 to L2 because the live catalog state can't be seen from the repo.
- **Fix, either of:**
  - Retag the catalog first and say so in the PR body or runbook.
  - Put the filter behind a `features.*` flag so it can be turned off without a redeploy.

## Worth a ticket / quick follow-up

### 2. No test checks that the space-specific link wins on a shared id (Medium · P3 · confirmed)
**Where:** `src/modules/billing/routes/billing.service.ts:167-173`

- **What:** The two "shared id" tests (`billing.service.spec.ts:342-364` and `billing.controller.e2e-spec.ts:285-317`) both use a paid general link for a space that has never subscribed.
  - `isOfferedToSpace` already removes that link at `payment-link-offer.rules.ts:61`, so it never reaches the id-keyed `Map`.
  - As a result, reversing the spread order or dropping the dedupe entirely would leave both tests green.
- **Fix:** add a case where the general link really is offered (`hasEverSubscribed: true`, a paid link whose plan name differs from the current one), and assert that the space link still wins.
- **Adjudication:** the validator CONFIRMED it and the refuter said it STANDS.

## Your call

| # | Finding | Where | Risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | `parseEnforcementStartsAt` accepts a date-only value such as `'2026-10-01'`, which the removed `DateStringSchema` check rejected, and no test covers it. Outside `NODE_ENV=test` the `RootConfigurationSchema` `z.iso.datetime()` check (`configuration.schema.ts:179`, via `configuration.validator.ts:14`) still rejects it when the app boots, so only test mode is exposed. Either add the test case or narrow the "fails loudly" comment. | `src/config/entities/configuration.ts:1070` | Low (refuter weakened it to I2/L1) |
| 4 | `warnedUnclassifiedLinkIds` on the singleton never evicts anything. It is fed only by the admin-curated general catalog, so in practice it stays small. | `src/modules/billing/routes/billing.service.ts:43` | Nit |

## Worth tidying

No proposals: you asked for a read-only review, and none of the passes found a cleanup worth suggesting.

## Not sure about these · Ruled out

**Not sure:**
- **`trialPeriodDays` may not be sent yet.** It is a new optional field (`src/datasources/billing-api/entities/payment-link.entity.ts:42`). If billing-api doesn't send it yet, every trial link is read as a paid link.
  - A space that has never subscribed would then see no general links at all (`payment-link-offer.rules.ts:61`).
  - The warning wouldn't fire either, because it only looks at trial links.
  - Check this with the billing-api owners before deploying.

**Ruled out:**
- **First checkout failed (`incomplete` / `incomplete_expired`) → no trial ever again.** Intended; tested at `subscriptions.repository.integration.spec.ts:199-212`.
- **Active plan with no name → every paid link is offered.** Intended; tested at `payment-link-offer.rules.spec.ts:72-82`.
- **Raw-SQL aliases and the boolean `COUNT(*) > 0`.** Safe, and the same pattern already exists at `space-audit.repository.ts:105`.
- **SQL injection.** `toSqlList` only inserts the hard-coded status list, and `spaceId` is bound as a parameter.
- **DI cycles.** Adding `EntitlementsRepositoryModule` creates no cycle.
- **`findCreatedAtById` refactor.** Keeps the same `NotFoundException`.
- **Uncached upstream calls.** Both `listPaymentLinks` calls go through `CacheFirstDataSource` (`billing-api.service.ts:158`).
- **Missing index.** `IDX_subscriptions_space_id_last_event_at` serves the `space_id` filter.
- **SPDX headers.** Present on all 24 files.
- **`ForbiddenException`.** Matches how sibling route services reject requests.

## How this was produced

- **Passes:** 3 reviewer agents covered the 9 areas (security+bugs+regression, testing+conventions, architecture+performance+DRY+KISS), producing 4 findings.
- **Adjudication:** each finding went to one validator and one refuter. The validator that had all three of findings 2–4 only addressed finding 2, so the verdicts on findings 3 and 4 rest on the refuter alone.
- **Deferral:** the testing pass handed finding 3 to regression; regression looked and found no production impact, and the refuter agreed.
- **Final tally:** confirmed 2, weakened 2, refuted 0.
